referenceEdition: Diablo II: Resurrected — Reign of the Warlock
source: User firsthand gameplay report and explicit design approval in this session; not an instrumented capture
observedReferenceBehavior: With less than two mana, Zeal stops and does nothing.
approvedDeviation: An unaffordable Zeal attempt uses one ordinary attack. Held Zeal continues ordinary attacks until enough mana returns, then resumes Zeal.
userApproval: it stops and does nothing. but we'll just turn it into an auto attack. not even doing that would just feel bad.
implementationScope: Learned/available Zeal and supported melee target/weapon gates remain required.
Use the shared ordinary attack timing, hit, damage and cancellation path without Zeal damage/AR, sequence, uninterruptibility or mana debit.
Retain left/right/quick bindings and held Zeal identity.
No fallback is granted to other skills or unrelated equipment/target failures.
limits: The legacy AttackNoMana table flag does not override the observed modern behavior or authorize general fallback for every skill.
Native tests cover server input and combat state; actual client presentation remains unverified.
